watch.summary: The streamer passionately celebrates team NRG calling two timeouts against 100 Thieves, claiming 100 Thieves is inside their heads.

beats.what: Streamer excitedly points out that the opposing team called two timeouts in a single half.
He slams his desk and stands up from his chair in excitement.
He screams that 100 Thieves is in their heads and flexes the logo on his shirt.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: We're in their heads! I'm telling you!
watch.why: The clip relies on esports context to understand why taking two timeouts signifies mental defeat. It delivers high-energy hype and fan passion rather than structured comedy.
